events.title: Sunshine Coast National Art Prize 2026 Finalists Exhibition
events.description: An exhibition showcasing the finalists of the prestigious national art prize, featuring diverse contemporary works from artists across Australia. It offers a chance to engage with current trends and creative techniques in the Australian visual arts scene.

events.title: DESTASH MARKET – Arts, Crafts & Sewing Supplies
events.description: A community-focused market where local creatives gather to sell and trade surplus art, craft, and sewing supplies. It is an excellent spot to meet local makers and source materials for future creative projects.

events.title: The Big Bike Film Night – Nambour Screening
events.description: A curated collection of short films focused on cycling culture, human-powered adventure, and storytelling. This event brings together outdoor enthusiasts and film lovers in an intimate cinema setting.
